Coleus Attempts
The first time I tried coleus, I gathered about 10 large leaves, chewed them, and kept them in my mouth for about 1 minute per leaf.  After this, I sat back and waited.  I know that this is considered a very small dose, but I couldnt just take 50-70 leaves out of my moms garden, and I had read reports of active doses in this range.  The plant was a Kong Coleus, which I have heard to be active on other sites.
I was expecting a calm mood and maybe slight visual alterations, but was also extremely cautious to avoid mistaking any placebo effect for a high.  I guess I was also slightly nervous, as this was to be my first drug experience (aside from alcohol, caffeine, etc.).  I waited 1.5 hours, but nothing happened.  I was well prepared, as I had read and reread every bit of information,
.  At this point, it was about 2 am (a normal summer bedtime for me, as I usually stay up late and read
), and I was tired, so I decided to go to sleep and see if I could at least experience some lucid dreams, like I had read about.  I experienced nothing, making this first attempt a failure.
Attempt 2
I tried to smoke some dried coleus, but had no rolling papers, and used loose leaf.  The leaves were air-dried over the course of about 1.5 weeks.  Although I had heard that drying the leaf removes its psychoactive potential, I decided it would be worth a try, because it is not that well studied, so the reports could be wrong.  I rolled a small joint of about 1 leaf (smoking dosages tend to be lower than oral dosages, and this was my first time smoking, so I wanted to keep it small).  Needless to say, the paper was harsh, and the coleus stank awfully.  This was the nastiest smoke I have ever smelled.  The first drag was my last, and I put it out.  I felt a little calm, but this could have easily been placebo.
Attempt 3
I was bored, and I thought I would try another smoke.  I rolled a larger joint this time, and used 3 leaves.  The first drag left me coughing, but I was persistent, and took 2 or three more.  After this, I quit and put it out.  I ground up the remaining embers of leaf, and attempted to insufflate them, but this had limited success, and it is not likely that much, if any, was absorbed.  I went back to The Proud Highway by Hunter S. Thompson, which I had been reading, but couldnt concentrate because I was now suffering from a very bad headache, and nausea.  I took 500 mg of acetaminophen (Tylenol), but it didnt seem to help.  At this point, I decided to cut my losses and get some sleep (this was about 1:30 am).  I woke up at about 11:00 am, feeling nauseas, and with a headache, but each was reduced.
Conclusion: I was unable to achieve noticeable effects through these methods and doses.  I didnt try a tea, because I would probably need as many, if not more, leaves as for an oral dose.  I will never try to smoke coleus again, and threw away my remaining leaves today.  If I ever get about 60 leaves, I will try them orally.  My type of plant is supposed to be active, so I dont think that this was the cause of failure.
